body.message:
I'm looking for a studio, 1-bedroom apartment, or hotel apartment in Dubai *with furniture*
My budget is *AED 3,000–3,500 per month maximum, preferably including bills.* I can commit to *at least 6 months,* and I'm looking for a stable long-term place.
The most important thing is that it must be *within easy walking distance of a Metro station, as I don't have a car.*
I work *in Jebel Ali,* so I would prefer somewhere convenient to commute to Jebel Ali.
If you have anything suitable, please send me the *monthly price, whether bills are included, exact location, distance to the Metro, and photos/videos.*
Thank you.
